people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
translations.bsb: Now Sarah lived to be 127 years old.
translations.kjv: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
translations.asv: And the life of Sarah was a hundred and seven and twenty years. These were the years of the life of Sarah.
